role: The SwiftUI App declaration: builds the root singletons (collector, sync, settings, StoreKit, language, voice chat, Watch bridge) as @State, assembles the root view (MainTabView + environment + launch modals + scene-phase handlers + interrupted-session alerts + launch tasks), wires Watch->phone control closures, and holds the @main entry EmuquMain.
types: LaunchModal: enum — which full-screen launch cover is up (disclaimer/onboarding/paywall/trialReminder/scoreArchitectureChange)
InterruptedSessionInfo: struct — a recording found persisted at launch; isResumable gates the resume alert
EmuquApp: struct (App) — app root; extended by AppLaunchTasks.swift and AppLaunchRecovery.swift
EmuquMain: enum (@main) — process entry, runs UI-test wipe + crash handlers before EmuquApp.main()
state: mem:coldStartLog (file-private OSLog subsystem com.chrissharp.flowrecovery category ColdStart)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers of EmuquApp call the seven makeX() factories (EmuquApp.swift:86-99), so every root singleton is built when EmuquApp.main() instantiates the App struct, after EmuquMain.main() has run the UI-test wipe and diagnostics install. emailBridge reads AssistantEmailBridge.shared directly (106). LaunchModal conforms to Identifiable for fullScreenCover(item:). The file reads `.shared` singletons directly (it is whitelisted as composition root by scripts/check_no_shared_outside_root.sh) while the AppLaunchTasks/AppLaunchRecovery extensions read the same services through AppDependencies.current.

flags.text: Root code reads singletons two ways: EmuquApp.swift uses `.shared` directly (RecorderBox.shared, PowerStatePolicy.shared, MorningNotificationScheduler.shared, AmbientLocationService.shared) while the extensions use AppDependencies.current overrides for the same services; prebindWorkoutRecorder binds RecorderBox.shared while the Watch listeners read AppDependencies.current.app.recorderBox, so a test override of recorderBox makes the pre-bind and the listeners use different boxes.

No unit or UI test references EmuquApp, LaunchModal, InterruptedSessionInfo, the launch-modal ordering, the Watch refusal logic or the scene-phase handler (grep of EmuquTests finds only a comment mention).

flags.text: Two access predicates exist for the same gate: storeKitManager.hasActiveAccess (isPurchased || hasBypassGrant, StoreKitManager.swift:627) here and in presentPaywallIfNowRequired, and EmuquApp.hasAccess (AppLaunchTasks.swift:700) in paywallModal/watch refusals/startWorkoutFromWatch. They differ under -UITests-ForcePaywall: hasAccess returns false unconditionally while hasActiveAccess still honours the persisted Skip (Debug) grant (StoreKitManager.swift:540-543), so the launch gate and onboarding-completion gate can disagree in Debug UI runs.

flags.text: Archiving on background runs in a plain Task with no background-task assertion (acceptance does HealthKit fetches, analysis and archive writes; BackgroundTaskAssertion is used only by MorningProcessingService, WorkoutRecorder+Stop and SystemDiagnosticsManager), so iOS can suspend the app mid-acceptance and the 'not lost if the user forgets' promise depends on getting enough background time.
